concerns.text: Task T023 performs a *post‑hoc* power analysis on the filtered dataset and then uses the achieved power (≥ 80 %) as a success criterion (SC‑009). Post‑hoc power is a deterministic function of the observed effect size and p‑value, so it does not provide an independent assessment of study adequacy; it is effectively circular validation of the same data used to estimate the effect.

Functional Requirement FR‑010 specifies a multiple‑comparison correction (e.g., Benjamini‑Hochberg FDR), but the implementation plan applies a Bonferroni correction (Task T020). This mismatch may lead to overly conservative inference and conflicts with the specification.
